name: CChitin::AsynchronousUpdate
needs: ours also wrong: at the same-position branch the exe compares the wheel tick count and falls through into OnMouseMove with the stored pointer position (0x78f4a5-0x78f4a7 cmp %ebp,%ebx / jle, OnMouseMove fed from the stored m_ptPointer at 0x78f4be-0x78f51e); ours tests a local that is never written. m_bPointerUpdated (+0x1902) has a single exe write, cleared in the ScreenToClient path's position-changed branch (0x78f4fd); ours also clears it in the outside-window path where the exe has no +0x1902 store (0x78f3e6-0x78f3f0). Fix: gate OnMouseMove on the wheel tick count and pass the stored pointer position, and clear m_bPointerUpdated only in the position-changed branch.
